test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a589c154b0f0cf859c63241616e45975a2b16283317f0d1fc620e26257a1419.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Cross sign is shifted toward right upper side and make boundary around the cross figure, then shifted toward right bottom corner, then shifted toward left bottom corner and make boundary around the cross figure, finally shifted left upper corner.

2) Pentagon is shifted toward left upper side and coloured with black colour, then shifted toward right upper corner, then shifted toward right bottom corner and coloured with black colour, finally shifted left bottom corner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63b4f37f0e1fbeaa359eded1ede94eee2b073869d5a3781a518f4c60f5da7379.png] 

3) Middle figure arrow rotate 45º anticlockwise in every next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4487d525c90e481e9d4b7d3d1948b7bc729a2602824e1270f242a00d0d94d08e.png] 

4) Quadrilateral is shifted toward left bottom side and clear the black colour, then shifted toward left upper corner, then shifted toward right upper corner and clear the black colour, finally shifted right bottom corner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72d02f54a3067311f0d18fc25c57a9417ca582e1c57079288e2ddd46f46ba0d8.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
